summary: The filing on Form 6-K reports AIFU Inc.'s announcement of a 1-for-20 reverse stock split approved by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on April 29, 2026, effective June 16, 2026. The split consolidates every 20 Class A and Class B ordinary shares into one, with fractional shares rounded up. Post-split outstanding shares will be approximately 6.18 million. The action is a routine share structure adjustment to meet Nasdaq listing requirements, not a capital return or any other special situation. There are no deal terms, price per share, premium, or acquisition elements. The event is a standard corporate action with no special-situation classification.
